travelGuide.history: Tirumala is the sacred abode of Lord Sri Venkateswara (Balaji), located atop the seven holy peaks of the Seshachalam Hills. As per temple tradition, a pilgrimage to Tirumala is traditionally completed with the blessings of Goddess Sri Padmavathi Ammavari at Tiruchanur.
travelGuide.timings:
• Suprabhatam: 03:00 AM
• VIP Break Darshan: 06:00 AM – 08:30 AM
• Special Entry Darshan (₹300): 09:00 AM – 10:00 PM
• Sarva Darshan (Free / SSD): 08:30 AM – 11:30 PM
travelGuide.dressCode:
Strict Traditional Attire Mandatory as per TTD regulations.
• Men: White Dhoti with shirt or Kurta Pyjama or Dhoti with Angavastram (Jeans, T-shirts, shorts strictly prohibited).
• Women: Saree, Half-saree, or Chudidhar/Salwar with Dupatta neatly pinned (Jeans, leggings, western wear strictly prohibited).
• Children: Modest traditional clothing or clean Indian attire.
tips: Official TTD Portal: Book ₹300 Special Entry Darshan tickets only on the official TTD portal (ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in) or the TTDevasthanams official mobile app. Quotas open 2–3 months ahead.

Original Physical ID Mandatory: The original Aadhaar card or Passport entered during online booking must be produced at the Vaikuntam scanning queue. Digital photos or photocopies are strictly rejected.

No Online Tickets? Free SSD Tokens: Devotees without online tickets can get free Slotted Sarva Darshan (SSD) tokens using their Aadhaar at Tirupati counters (Bhudaevi Complex near Alipiri, Srinivasam Complex, or Vishnu Nivasam).
Senior Citizens & Infants: TTD offers dedicated Supadham entry for senior citizens (65+ with Aadhaar) and parents traveling with infants under 1 year during designated time windows.
Electronic Devices Prohibited: Smartphones, smartwatches, power banks, and cameras are strictly banned inside the sanctum sanctorum and must be deposited in TTD cloakrooms before entering the queue.

faq.q: How much does a Chennai to Tirupati car package cost?
faq.a: Our flat round-trip fares start from ₹6,000 for a 4-passenger AC Sedan (Swift Dzire / Etios), ₹7,500 for a 6-passenger Ertiga SUV, ₹8,500 for a 7-passenger Toyota Innova, ₹10,000 for an Innova Crysta, and ₹12,500 for a 12-seater Tempo Traveller. All fares are 100% all-inclusive covering car, fuel, AP border permit, NH tolls, Alipiri toll, and driver allowance.

faq.q: Can we complete Tirupati Darshan from Chennai in one day?
faq.a: Yes! Our 1-Day Same Day package departs Chennai by 04:00 AM, reaches Tirumala by 08:30 AM, completes Special Entry Darshan by 02:00 PM, visits Tiruchanur Padmavathi Ammavari Temple by 03:30 PM, and drops you safely back at your doorstep in Chennai by 09:00 PM.

faq.q: Can you arrange or bundle TTD ₹300 Darshan tickets?
faq.a: Under strict TTD regulations, all darshan tickets must be booked directly by devotees on the official TTD portal (ttdevasthanams.ap.gov.in) linked to their personal Aadhaar or Passport numbers. Travel operators cannot legally pre-purchase or resell tickets under generic names. We coordinate your doorstep vehicle pickup and timings to match your booked darshan time slot.

faq.q: What if we don't have online TTD ₹300 tickets booked in advance?
faq.a: You can still visit Tirupati! Devotees without advance online tickets can obtain free Slotted Sarva Darshan (SSD) tokens at Tirupati counters (Bhudaevi Complex near Alipiri, Srinivasam, or Vishnu Nivasam) with their original Aadhaar. For SSD darshan, we recommend our 2 Days / 1 Night package so you can rest and attend darshan peacefully without exhaustion.

faq.q: Are Andhra Pradesh border permit, FASTag tolls, and parking included in the fare?
faq.a: Yes, 100% included. You never have to pay any extra cash on the road for the Andhra Pradesh Interstate Tourist Tax, National Highway tolls, Alipiri ghat tolls, or temple parking. Everything is clearly transparent with zero surprise charges.

faq.q: What is the official dress code for Tirupati Darshan in 2026?
faq.a: TTD enforces strict traditional dress. Men must wear a white Dhoti with shirt or Kurta Pyjama or Dhoti with Angavastram (Jeans, shorts, and western t-shirts are prohibited). Women must wear a Saree, Half-saree, or Chudidhar/Salwar with Dupatta pinned across shoulders (Jeans, leggings, sleeveless tops are prohibited).

faq.q: Is Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple (Tiruchanur) included?
faq.a: Yes! According to pilgrimage tradition, visiting Goddess Padmavathi at Tiruchanur completes the Tirupati pilgrimage. A dedicated stop at Tiruchanur is included in all our packages before heading back to Chennai.

faq.q: Is this package convenient for senior citizens and young families?
faq.a: Extremely convenient. We provide clean, air-conditioned vehicles with easy step-stool access, doorstep pickup anywhere in Chennai, and drop devotees as close as authorized near the queue complex in Tirumala. Our polite, experienced drivers assist with luggage and navigating cloakrooms.

faq.q: Is any advance payment required to book the vehicle?
faq.a: No advance payment is required for booking confirmation. You can reserve your car instantly via WhatsApp or phone call, and pay after boarding or upon trip completion.

travelGuide.history: The Navagraha temples around Kumbakonam are centuries-old Chola architectural marvels dedicated to the nine celestial bodies. Performing pariharams at these specific sthalams is believed to nullify planetary afflictions (Doshas) and bring prosperity.
